title: The Harbor of the Cape Route
author: Ivo Oyelaran
blurb: Ulyana Almeida, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
